title: AEO Institutional Transparency and Public Disclosure
summary: The role of the official website evolved from a passive notification channel to an active transparency mechanism for Authorized Economic Operators (AEOs). It now serves as the primary platform for publishing lists of certified entities, status updates, and operational guidance.

evolution.function: Transitioned from a general information portal to a mandatory regulatory transparency tool for AEO management.
evolution.transparency: Increased requirement for real-time updates on entity status (suspension/cancellation).

timeline.change: Mandated the use of official websites for publishing AEO lists, focal point contact details, and status changes.

Authorized Economic Operator: The newly established center is tasked with supporting applicants by ensuring easy access to information regarding eligibility, application procedures, benefits, and relevant legal frameworks.
The center provides guidance to interested persons or entities during the application process and helps resolve queries regarding their applications.
The center is responsible for publishing and maintaining a digital record of entities that have received official recognition, including updating the status of such recognitions on official websites.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is responsible for the publication of recognized entities on its official website, ensuring that the list is kept current by removing those whose recognition has been suspended or cancelled.

member_objects.resolved_text: ৩. বিধিমালার বিধি ৩(৪) এর আওতায় প্রত্যেক কাস্টমস হাউস-এ বা নিজ অধিক্ষেত্রে কাস্টমস স্টেশন রয়েছে এরূপ কাস্টমস, এক্সাইজ ও ভ্যাট কমিশনারেটে জয়েন্ট কমিশনার বা কাস্টমস বা তদূর্ধ্ব পদমর্যাদার একজন কর্মকর্তা এর নেতৃত্বে প্রয়োজনীয় সংখ্যক অন্যান্য কর্মকর্তার সমন্বয়ে একটি করে অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর টিম গঠন করতে হবে এবং উক্ত টিম হতে একজন ফোকাল পয়েন্ট কর্মকর্তা মনোনয়ন প্রদান করতে হবে। ফোকাল পয়েন্ট কর্মকর্তা মনোনয়নের বিষয়টি কাস্টমস হাউস/কমিশনারেটের নোটিস বোর্ড, ওয়েবসাইট, দাপ্তরিক সামাজিক যোগাযোগ মাধ্যম (যেমন, পেইজ, গ্রুপ) এ যোগাযোগ নম্বর ও ই-মেইল আইডিসহ প্রচার করতে হবে।

Authorized Economic Operator: Each Customs House or Customs, Excise and VAT Commissionerate must establish a dedicated team to handle matters related to Authorized Economic Operators.
The team must be led by an officer at the rank of Joint Commissioner of Customs or higher and include an appropriate number of additional staff.
Focal Point Officer: An officer must be nominated as the dedicated focal point for the Authorized Economic Operator team.

The contact details of the nominated focal point, including telephone numbers and email addresses, must be publicized on the official website, social media channels, and notice boards of the relevant Customs House or Commissionerate.
Customs House: Each Customs House is required to form an Authorized Economic Operator team and ensure the nomination and public disclosure of a focal point officer for external communication.
Customs, Excise and VAT Commissionerate: Every Commissionerate that includes a customs station must establish an Authorized Economic Operator team and ensure that the contact information for its focal point officer is made available to the public.

member_objects.resolved_text: ১৯. AEO সেন্টার স্বীকৃতিপ্রাপ্ত প্রতিষ্ঠানের নামে নিজস্ব ওয়েবসাইটে প্রকাশ ও নিয়মিত হালনাগাদ করবে। এক্ষেত্রে স্বীকৃতি সনদপ্রাপ্ত প্রতিষ্ঠানের শ্রেণি উন্নয়ন/অবনমন বা সনদ স্থগিত ও বাতিলের ক্ষেত্রে উক্ত তথ্যসমূহ ওয়েবসাইটে নিয়মিত হালনাগাদ করতে হবে।

Authorized Economic Operator: The AEO Center is responsible for publishing and maintaining an updated list of accredited entities on its official website. It must also reflect any changes in the status of these entities, such as upgrades, downgrades, suspension, or cancellation of their accreditation, in a timely manner.

Authorized Economic Operators must have their accreditation status managed and publicly disclosed by the AEO Center. Their operational standing, including any status changes or sanctions, is subject to periodic updating on the official portal.
